entries.name: Deepslate
entries.description: The sixteen colours a block game writes its chat in, as the sixteen colours a terminal has, on near-black stone. Drawn for Cobble and a plain, bright dark theme without it.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Dracula
entries.description: The purple one. Published palette, verbatim, including its ANSI set.
entries.author: Dracula Theme

entries.name: Dungeon
entries.description: The palette an 8-bit console could show, on the navy of a dungeon floor, with a gold cursor. Drawn for Quest.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Gruvbox Dark
entries.description: Retro groove, dark medium. Warm greys and the brightest status marks here.
entries.author: Pavel Pertsev

entries.name: Ironclad
entries.description: Gunmetal and one red. Drawn for the skin of the same name, and a perfectly good dark theme without it.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Nord
entries.description: Arctic, north-bluish, and the lowest-contrast thing in this list. Sixteen published colours and no more.
entries.author: Arctic Ice Studio

entries.name: One Dark
entries.description: Atom's, and the one most people have already been looking at for ten years.
entries.author: Atom (GitHub)

entries.name: Pea Soup
entries.description: Four greens and nothing else in the terminal, on grey plastic. Every ANSI slot is dark on light, so nothing an agent prints can disappear.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Tokyo Night
entries.description: Folke's night flavour — deep indigo, and the one here with the quietest chrome.
entries.author: Folke Lemaitre

entries.name: Underground
entries.description: The same 8-bit palette on pure black, with the blue of an underground level for the cursor and the accent. Drawn for World 1-1.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Cobble
entries.description: An inventory screen: grey plates around every pane, slots for tabs, a stone button, experience along the bottom, sand and cobblestone behind. Wear it with Deepslate.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Handheld
entries.description: Grey plastic, a dark screen bezel around every pane with a power light in the corner, magenta buttons and a speaker grille. Wear it with Pea Soup and the terminals are the screen.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Ironclad
entries.description: Riveted steel around every pane, a HUD along the bottom, and a red line for the one you are in. Pixel art at 3x — the terminals get smaller and that is the idea.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Quest
entries.description: An 8-bit dungeon: blue stone walls around every pane, item boxes for tabs, a black HUD with a map and three hearts, gold on what you picked. Wear it with Dungeon.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: World 1-1
entries.description: Brick blocks in a blue sky. The pane you are in is a gold block with four dots, the tab strip a pipe, every dialog a cloud, the ground along the bottom. Wear it with Underground.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Bear
entries.description: Lumbers along while it works, and breathes very slowly while it does not.
entries.author: ScratchIO

entries.name: Boar
entries.description: Trots head-down and unbothered while it works, and stands there breathing while it waits.
entries.author: ScratchIO

entries.name: Cat
entries.description: Pads across the badge while it works, and hands it back to the dot when it stops. A black cat, so it is a silhouette with one green eye.
entries.author: Shepardskin

entries.name: Deer
entries.description: Walks while it works, and stands very still otherwise.
entries.author: ScratchIO

entries.name: Dog
entries.description: A small pup that scurries while it works and stands wagging while it waits. Three of them on the sheet — the other two are a row away.
entries.author: Jason of GDN

entries.name: Fish
entries.description: Swims while it works and blows bubbles while it waits. The sheet holds twelve colours — Settings can re-cut it to any of them.
entries.author: chips8688

entries.name: Fox
entries.description: Trots while it works, sits and looks about while it waits.
entries.author: ScratchIO

entries.name: Gull
entries.description: Beats its wings while it works and glides while it waits — the same five frames, slowed to a quarter speed.
entries.author: MoikMellah

entries.name: Hawk
entries.description: The gull's brown neighbour on the same sheet. Beats hard while it works, circles while it waits.
entries.author: MoikMellah

entries.name: Hero
entries.description: A small person in a green tunic and a pointed cap, with a sword out. For a window made of dungeon walls.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Horse
entries.description: Walks while it works. Its idle is thirteen frames long, which is the slowest thing in here and reads as breathing.
entries.author: ScratchIO

entries.name: Knight
entries.description: A figure in a full steel helm with the visor down, sword drawn. For the riveted window, and for anybody who wants to be looked at sternly.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Miner
entries.description: A bearded person in a hard hat with the lamp lit, carrying a pick. For the inventory-screen window.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Plumber
entries.description: A short person in a red cap and blue overalls, bouncing along. For a window made of bricks and blue sky.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Rabbit
entries.description: Hops while it works, twitches while it waits. The smallest sheet here and the one that reads best at 16px.
entries.author: ScratchIO

entries.name: Songbird
entries.description: Flies while it works and pecks at the ground while it waits. The sheet holds eight animations; Settings can re-cut it.
entries.author: rmazanek

entries.name: Whale
entries.description: Swims while it works, and hands the badge back to the dot when it stops. The trim is a window on its head — an orca does not fit in a square.
entries.author: Mepavi @ You're Perfect Studio

entries.name: Wolf
entries.description: Runs flat out while it works. Howls at nothing while it waits.
entries.author: ScratchIO

entries.name: Anvil
entries.description: Struck steel — a transient and two inharmonic partials ringing on. For Ironclad, and for anybody who wants to be told firmly.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Blip
entries.description: A two-note menu blip on a thin square wave, over in a fifth of a second. The quietest way a device can say something.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Coin
entries.description: The two-note blip a coin makes, up a fifth and held. For a window made of bricks and blue sky.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Fanfare
entries.description: Four notes up a major chord, square over triangle: the noise a thing being found makes. For Quest.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Knock
entries.description: A block set down: a sine bent down fourteen semitones with a little grit on the front. The one to pick to be told without being interrupted.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Cobble
entries.description: An inventory screen around a chat-coloured terminal, a miner with a pick, and a block being set down. Blocks.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Handheld
entries.description: Grey plastic, four greens, a rabbit, and the two-note blip a menu makes. Your agents in a screen you can hold in two hands.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Ironclad
entries.description: The steel skin with the palette it was drawn against, a knight with the visor down, and struck metal. The whole window in one click.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: Quest
entries.description: Blue stone walls, a black HUD with three hearts, an 8-bit palette on navy, somebody small with a sword, and four notes up a major chord.
entries.author: kururu-styles

entries.name: World 1-1
entries.description: Bricks in a blue sky over a black underground terminal, a plumber in a red cap, and the noise a coin makes.
entries.author: kururu-styles
